title: Hyundai Bioscience unveils US clinical plan for dengue drug Zepti - CHOSUNBIZ - Chosunbiz

Hyundai Bioscience unveils US clinical plan for dengue drug Zepti - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 10월 26일(월) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Science Hyundai Bioscience unveils US clinical plan for dengue drug Zepti 
 입력 2026.10.26. 14:17 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 /Courtesy of Hyundai Bioscience Hyundai Bioscience(048410) science said on the 26th that it attended the Infectious Disease Week (ID Week) academic conference in Washington, D.C. It presented the clinical strategy for Zepti, a candidate substance that suppresses viruses.
 Zepti is undergoing phase 2/3 clinical trials in Vietnam for dengue patients. Vietnam reports more than 400,000 dengue cases every year. Because the weather is hot and humid, mosquitoes that transmit dengue proliferate easily.
 At the conference, David Smith, a professor at UC San Diego, shared Zepti's clinical data. The company said no severe adverse reactions appeared in the trials. Hyundai Bioscience plans to expand the target patients and scope of Zepti's treatment based on the clinical results.
 A company official said, "The goal is to treat febrile viral diseases such as Zika virus and influenza, along with dengue."
